description: Source file implementing the mac_test_mode_ue_repository class, managing UE test mode data in a 5G NR MAC layer context, including UE addition, removal, and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: mac_test_mode_ue_repository
classes.description: Repository managing UE test mode information, including UE addition, removal, and configuration queries.

methods.name: get_cell_index
methods.description: Calculates the cell index based on RNTI.

methods.name: rnti_to_du_ue_idx
methods.description: Converts RNTI to DU UE index.

methods.name: get_sched_ue_cfg_request
methods.description: Retrieves scheduling configuration request for a given RNTI.

methods.name: find_sched_ue_cfg_request
methods.description: Finds scheduling configuration request for a given RNTI, returns nullptr if not found.

methods.name: is_msg4_rxed
methods.description: Checks if message 4 has been received for a RNTI.

methods.name: msg4_rxed
methods.description: Marks message 4 as received for a RNTI.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the repository, dispatching creation to the appropriate cell thread.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the repository, dispatching removal to the appropriate cell thread.
